creativeDirection: Brokers and shipping teams keep a network of transporters’ reported space, routes and approximate locations in one view. Grounded East African freight-yard artwork; minimal text; tracking secondary.

en.teaser: A load comes in. Which of your transporters has room for it? Loadgistic brings the space and routes they report onto one map, so you know where to start before you call. Keep your regular transporters close, and find new options when you need them. Try it now at loadgistic.com. Android app coming soon.
en.private-network: The trucks you know. The space you need. Ask the transporters you work with to share with your email, then see their reported space and routes together on your private map. Less starting from scratch. A clearer place to begin your next load. loadgistic.com
en.transporter: Let your next customer see the space you have. Share your truck’s available room and routes with the brokers and shipping teams you work with. You choose who sees it: your contacts, the public, both, or one recipient. loadgistic.com
en.public-discovery: Your usual truck can’t take this load? Find another place to start. Explore public capacity on Loadgistic and narrow it to the route, truck and space you need. Check the latest report, then call the transporter and agree on the job. loadgistic.com
en.tracking: The job is agreed. Keep everyone in the picture. Give the people involved private shipment updates, approximate location and loading and unloading photos—without making the shipment public. loadgistic.com

am.teaser: ከሚሠሩባቸው አጓጓዦች የትኛው ለቀጣዩ ጭነትዎ ቦታ አለው? ያሳወቁትን የጭነት ቦታና መስመር በLoadgistic በአንድ ካርታ ይዩ። በኢሜይልዎ እንዲያጋሩዎት ይጠይቁ፤ ለሁሉም ክፍት የሆኑ መኪኖችንም ማየት ይችላሉ። loadgistic.com አሁን ይጎብኙ። የAndroid አፕ በቅርቡ ይመጣል።

om.teaser: Geejjibdoota waliin hojjettan keessaa eenyutu feʼumsa keessan itti aanuuf iddoo qaba? Iddoo feʼumsaa fi karaa isaan beeksisan Loadgistic irratti kaartaa tokko keessatti ilaalaa. Odeeffannoo isaanii imeelii keessaniif akka qoodan gaafadhaa; konkolaattota uummataaf banaa taʼanis ilaaluun ni dandaʼama. Amma loadgistic.com daawwadhaa. Appiin Android dhihootti ni dhufa.

so.teaser: Gaadiidleyda aad la shaqeyso, kee baa boos u haya xamuulkaaga xiga? Loadgistic hal khariidad kaga eeg booska iyo waddooyinka ay sheegeen. Ka codso inay xogtooda la wadaagaan iimaylkaaga, ama eeg gaadiidka dadweynaha u furan. Hadda booqo loadgistic.com. App-ka Android dhawaan ayuu imanayaa.

ti.teaser: ካብ እትሰርሑ ምስኦም ኣጓዓዝቲ፣ ንዝቕጽል ጽዕነትኩም ቦታ ዘለዎ መን እዩ? ዝሓበርዎ ናይ ጽዕነት ቦታን መስመርን ኣብ Loadgistic ብሓንቲ ካርታ ርኣዩ። ብኢመይልኩም ክካፈሉኹም ሕተቱ፤ ንኹሉ ክፉታት መካይን እውን ክትርእዩ ትኽእሉ። ሕጂ loadgistic.com ብጽሑ። ናይ Android ኣፕ ብቐረባ ይመጽእ።
